fixed.summary: Small labels over the scene sit on a HUD plate (`Plate.frame` over `bg-glass`, the pack's plate art where a pack dresses it) instead of a 1.5 px text-stroke halo that read faint over a bright sky: AmmoCounter's reserve weapon, its weapon and fire-mode line, Reloading and Reload; Nameplate's name, title, cast and percent (one plate; compact, the bar alone, has none); Waypoint's label, now in `text-fg` with the kind's colour on the diamond; LapHud's places gained or lost. Large figures (the magazine count, the race position) keep the halo, and LapHud's total racers (/8) gains it. LapHud's lap label and lap total are `text-fg-muted` instead of a thinned ink, and Waypoint's far state no longer fades its distance tag. Fix: none; a game that wrapped these labels in its own plate can drop it.
A magazine tick lit for each round left is drawn in the ink (`bg-fg`) over an unlit `bg-track` tick, as is the continuous strip past 60 rounds; lit and unlit ticks were the same colour.
The health bar draws its fill, ghost and shield again: their clip box had no width, so the bar showed its track only.
